findings.summary: Removes the foreign-push abort added in AISDLC-1098. If refs/remotes/origin/<branch> did not exist before the push, seenBeforeFetch is undefined. leasePushOwnRebaseShip then sets recorded = seenBeforeFetch ?? (await sha()), and sha() now reads the ref the outer git fetch just created, so the re-fetch check passes and it runs --force-with-lease pinned to a remote tip this run never saw. Before this change recorded was '' and the function returned null (abort). Scenario: no remote-tracking ref for the task branch (developer pass pushed from another clone, or another session pushed); the plain push is rejected, the fetch shows the remote tip is not an ancestor, and the lease push overwrites the other commits. Fix: set seenBeforeFetch to '' instead of undefined when rev-parse fails, so a never-seen tip still aborts; add a test where rev-parse fails before the fetch and assert no --force-with-lease push is issued.
